thread.title: Pay.gov maintenance scheduled for June 6 may affect payment services

author: pelican state news
title: Pay.gov maintenance scheduled for June 6 may affect payment services
text:
Pay.gov will undergo software maintenance on Saturday, June 6, beginning at 5:00 pm, according to an announcement on June 3. The scheduled maintenance is expected to last three hours.
During this period, all Pay.gov websites may be unavailable. As a result, Case Management/Electronic Case Files (CM/ECF) e-filers might not be able to make payments through Pay.gov.
The notice advises users who experience issues during the maintenance window to contact the Clerk’s office first thing Monday morning, June 8.
No additional background information was provided regarding the nature of the software updates or previous impacts from similar maintenance activities.
